en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a river bend with steep rocky banks and rural buildings in the background. In the foreground a crowded paddle steamer with a tall smokestack moves along the river, leaving a wake. Trees and low fields line the banks. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Seußlitz‑Diesbar – Der große Elbebogen," referring to a large bend in the River Elbe between Seußlitz and Diesbar.
